tools.name: scan_trust
tools.description: Run Obelisk's public trust scan on an https URL — TLS and security-header posture, scored as an Obelisk Rating. Read-only, SSRF-guarded.

tools.name: verify_token
tools.description: Verify that a JSON Web Token was minted by this Obelisk Gate (ES256, correct issuer) and report its type, subject, assurance, and principal. Never returns secrets.

tools.name: get_org_rating
tools.description: Read the public Obelisk Rating (0-100 score, trust band, and trend) for a registered organization by its slug.

tools.name: verify_agent_run_proof
tools.description: Verify the structural integrity, agent binding, delegation continuity, and commitments of an Obelisk action-scoped run proof. Does not reveal or infer raw task data.

tools.name: get_agent_proof
tools.description: Read an Obelisk agent's public proof vector by opaque proof id. Returns independent claims with freshness and scope; never a scalar trust score or a claim of non-humanness.

tools.name: transparency_head
tools.description: Read the current signed transparency head of Obelisk's tamper-evident receipt ledger — pin it and compare later to prove history only extends. Same data as /.well-known/obelisk-transparency.json.

tools.name: gate_status
tools.description: Read the Gate's public liveness facts: issuer, served code revision, OIDC availability, and supported protocols. No posture internals.

tools.name: explain_rating
tools.description: Deterministically explain what an Obelisk Rating number means: its trust band, how the public scan scores, and what typically moves a score. Pure function of the number — no data is read.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_token" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
